regions.full_page: God Bless you Mother Mary Hilda this happy feast day of most priviliged Grand-Mother dear St. Ann. I have started to write you several times these last more than six months, and whatever the trouble, I can hardly excuse myself for such negligence in failing to express my appreciation for your kind remembrances and to say thank you, as I want to do now at least, with a thousand times God bless you. I do hope that you keep up in health and courage, persevering in keeping the Faith and helping Jesus our Savior in the saving of poor sinner's souls - including our own of course, charity beginning at home. God help us! How little we appreciate our privilige of being given opportunity after opportunity of suffering in diverse ways and of offer- ing all in union with and for the intentions of the Sacred Heart of Jesus! I have been reading: "The Way of Divine Love; or The Message of the Sacred Heart to the World", as jotted down and noted by a most privi- leged contemporary of our own, the little, kitchen-lay-sister Josefa Menendeth, born in 1890 and called to Heaven December 29, 1923. - all in strict though gentlest obedience to Jesus and her superiors. What sufferings of soul and body she went through - what agonies she learned to welcome! - for the sake of helping Jesus to rescue straying souls! Glory be to God! Would that we might be convinced - that we might real- ize - in the time of temptation, of trial and struggle, and when the clouds seem most threatening that just then it is that Our Dear Lord in nearest and that just then too we ought to offer all to Jesus - turning to Him with the holy fear at once and the confidence of the Apostles :" Lord we perish! - Save us! " As still a child at home struggling to support herpoor parents, whose modest means had become exhausted through failing health and un- forseen family expenses, including the early death of her father, Josepha had learned many a practical lesson in patience, resignation, confidence in God; - humility permeatingall, supporting every step toward the heights of Calvary and confidence in Heaven.
